provider: Morningstar / Center for Research in Security Prices

required_deliverables.purpose: PERMNO-keyed historical ticker, share-class, exchange, security-type and listing intervals.
PERMCO issuer history retained separately from tradable-security identity.
Daily raw regular-session observations and status flags.
Delisting dates, reasons, actions, statuses, terms, successor identifiers and genuine terminal references.
Splits, dividends, rights, spin-offs and other distribution terms and dates.
Session calendar, flags, missing-value codes, schema and field semantics.
Every licensed as-received monthly or quarterly release from January 2016 onward.
Release identifiers, file census, hashes or integrity metadata, publication times and correction descriptions.

quarantined_vendor_fields.reason: Vendor return fields are outcomes or performance-adjacent and remain outside this phase and the outcome firewall.

delivery.storage_estimate: EXACT_C6Z_PLUS_ARCHIVED_RELEASE_FOOTPRINT_QUOTE_REQUIRED; AN OFFICIAL LEGACY PRODUCT MATRIX HAS LISTED APPROXIMATELY_3_3_GB_FOR_A_SINGLE_1962_US_STOCK_RELEASE_BUT_THIS_IS_NOT_A_VINTAGE_CORPUS_ESTIMATE

purchase_prerequisites.requirement: Archived as-received C6Z release corpus and manifests from January 2016 onward are licensable.
Release and event knowledge-time fields are sufficient for causal historical reconstruction.
2016-plus common-stock raw open, high, low, close and volume coverage is documented and source-admissible.
Corporate-action and terminal-event census, terms, identifiers and revisions satisfy the frozen contract.
Subscriber eligibility and automated local quantitative-research use are contractually permitted.
Immutable local landing, backups, derived canonical data and post-cancellation retention are contractually permitted.
An itemized quote identifies base, archive, setup, exchange and recurring costs and the exact delivery entitlement.

subsequent_ingestion_sequence.name: IMMUTABLE_LANDING
subsequent_ingestion_sequence.action: Land exact vendor bytes under a separately authorized immutable source-package root without transformation.

subsequent_ingestion_sequence.name: SOURCE_MANIFEST
subsequent_ingestion_sequence.action: Record provider, product, entitlement, release, files, retrieval and license classifications.

subsequent_ingestion_sequence.name: CONTENT_HASHING
subsequent_ingestion_sequence.action: Hash every raw file and partition before parsing.

subsequent_ingestion_sequence.name: SCHEMA_CAPTURE
subsequent_ingestion_sequence.action: Bind the delivered schema, metadata guide, missing-value codes and release version.

subsequent_ingestion_sequence.name: LICENSE_METADATA
subsequent_ingestion_sequence.action: Record the executed license class and confirmed storage, automation, derived-data and retention rights without secrets.

subsequent_ingestion_sequence.name: PROVIDER_ID_PRESERVATION
subsequent_ingestion_sequence.action: Preserve PERMNO, PERMCO and other delivered identifiers exactly.

subsequent_ingestion_sequence.name: STABLE_ID_INGESTION
subsequent_ingestion_sequence.action: Map PERMNO to the repository stable tradable-security layer without ticker-derived IDs.

subsequent_ingestion_sequence.name: HISTORICAL_TICKER_INTERVALS
subsequent_ingestion_sequence.action: Ingest and validate nonoverlapping PERMNO ticker intervals and ticker reuse.

subsequent_ingestion_sequence.name: HISTORICAL_EXCHANGE_INTERVALS
subsequent_ingestion_sequence.action: Ingest point-in-time exchange and listing validity under each PERMNO.

subsequent_ingestion_sequence.name: SECURITY_TYPE_MAPPING
subsequent_ingestion_sequence.action: Map documented CRSP share and security type codes to the frozen V1 taxonomy and quarantine ambiguity.

subsequent_ingestion_sequence.name: RAW_OHLCV_ADMISSION
subsequent_ingestion_sequence.action: Admit only qualified original unadjusted daily bars through historical_source_admission.py.

subsequent_ingestion_sequence.name: CORPORATE_ACTION_ADMISSION
subsequent_ingestion_sequence.action: Admit required action events with effective, knowledge-time, revision and stable-source identity.

subsequent_ingestion_sequence.name: TERMINAL_EVENT_ADMISSION
subsequent_ingestion_sequence.action: Admit source terminal metadata while denying vendor return fields and outcome calculations.

subsequent_ingestion_sequence.name: CALENDAR_BINDING
subsequent_ingestion_sequence.action: Bind source session dates to the accepted exchange calendar and classify discrepancies.

subsequent_ingestion_sequence.name: CROSS_SOURCE_RECONCILIATION
subsequent_ingestion_sequence.action: Confirm single-source PERMNO consistency; use no ticker-only joins and add no second provider unless separately approved.

subsequent_ingestion_sequence.name: FULL_CORPUS_VALIDATION
subsequent_ingestion_sequence.action: Run identity, interval, security-type, bar-integrity, survivorship, action and timestamp checks across the full corpus.

subsequent_ingestion_sequence.name: QUARANTINE
subsequent_ingestion_sequence.action: Quarantine every invalid, ambiguous, incomplete or outcome-bearing row with explicit reason codes and counts.

subsequent_ingestion_sequence.name: CANONICAL_PANEL_CONSTRUCTION
subsequent_ingestion_sequence.action: Build the real point-in-time panel only after all mandatory source families pass admission in the later authorized phase.

subsequent_ingestion_sequence.name: REAL_SOURCE_CAUSAL_INVARIANCE
subsequent_ingestion_sequence.action: Run prefix, future-mutation, snapshot-poisoning, universe, revision and availability tests without outcome access.

subsequent_ingestion_sequence.name: READINESS_GATE_RERUN
subsequent_ingestion_sequence.action: Recompute historical_source_readiness_gate_v2; passing still does not unlock outcomes.
